description: This Java source file contains unit tests for the PersonValidator class in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing validation logic for Person and Patient objects such as birthdate validation, death date validation, cause of death, and address validation.

classes.name: PersonValidatorTest
classes.description: Test class containing various test cases to validate the behavior of PersonValidator in different scenarios.

methods.name: setValidator
methods.description: Autowired setter method to inject the Validator instance designated as 'personValidator'.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfBirthdateIsAFutureDate
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when a Patient has a birthdate set in the future.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfDeathDateIsAFutureDate
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when a Patient has a death date set in the future.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfBirthdateMakesPatientOlderThat140YearsOld
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when the patient's birthdate makes them older than 140 years.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfCauseOfDeathIsBlankWhenPatientIsDead
methods.description: Validates that cause of death is required when patient is marked as dead.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfVoidReasonIsBlankWhenPatientIsVoided
methods.description: Checks that void reason is required if the patient record is voided.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfPersonDoesNotHaveAtleastOneNonVoidedName
methods.description: Ensures that at least one non-voided name exists for the person.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfGenderIsBlankForPersons
methods.description: Tests that validation passes even if gender is blank for Person objects.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Verifies that validation passes when field lengths are within acceptable limits.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Checks that validation fails when text fields exceed length constraints.

methods.name: shouldNotSetDeathBeforeBirth
methods.description: Ensures validation fails when death date is before birth date.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationWhenDeathCauseAndDeathCauseNonCodedAreSet
methods.description: Validation that fails if both cause of death coded and non-coded are set simultaneously.

methods.name: validate_shouldNotFailWhenDeathCauseNotCodedIsSet
methods.description: Test that validation passes when a non-coded cause of death is properly set.

methods.name: validate_shouldThrowExceptionWhenAddressIsNull
methods.description: Ensures that validation throws an IllegalArgumentException if a null address is present in person's addresses.
